mapper.select: SELECT ui.integrations_id AS integrationsId, ui.telegram_bot_token AS telegramBotToken, ui.telegram_chat_id AS telegramChatId FROM `user` u INNER JOIN user_integrations ui ON ui.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_code = #{userID} AND u.api_key = #{apiKey} AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND ui.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY ui.integrations_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question ( integrations_id, question, send_type ) VALUES ( #{integrationsId}, #{question}, '1' )
INSERT INTO answer ( question_id, prev_answer_id, answer, feedback ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, NULL, #{answer}, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT a.answer_id AS answerId, a.question_id AS questionId, a.answer AS previousAnswer, q.question, ui.telegram_bot_token AS telegramBotToken, ui.telegram_chat_id AS telegramChatId FROM answer a INNER JOIN question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN user_integrations ui ON ui.integrations_id = q.integrations_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY a.answer_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer ( question_id, prev_answer_id, answer, feedback ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{prevAnswerId}, #{answer}, #{feedback} )
mapper.update: UPDATE answer SET tel_send_type = #{telSendType}, tel_send_date = CASE WHEN #{telSendType} = '1' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}
